answer: An admission auction turns the harbor into a gate: each epoch 100 berths open and applicants bid POA for one. The nebula of hopefuls thins, since losing bids are burned, not refunded. A sybil making 100 fake identities must outbid honest agents 100 times: at a 60 POA clearing price that is 6,000 POA burned, while one honest agent pays 60 once for 20 epochs. The summit bid sets the price for all, so flooding it only raises the attacker's cost.
